design_note:
P4b design (plan §10.2 + §7.2-7.4), attempt 2 - packed calls.
1. Gold sample unchanged: 120 chunks / 29 packs stratified on doc_type x era, seed seed_for("P4B").
2. Calls are the plan §7.2 shape: identical STATIC_PROMPT, one document per call, up to 6 consecutive
   chunks / ~3.5k chunk tokens, one trailing <known_entities>, temp 0, reasoning off (documented
   per-provider switches: reasoning_effort / chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking=false).
3. References = deepseek-v4-pro + glm-5.3 (two families). glm-5.3 hides a reasoning trace inside the
   completion budget, so the plan's 2,500-token cap truncated 16/29 packs; probe found no full-off
   switch for its JSON transport, and reasoning_effort=minimal with an 8,000-token cap then returns
   complete JSON (0/29 truncated). Both references cover 120/120 chunks packed, so the single-chunk
   supplement path stays unused as a fallback.
4. One-reference disagreements are all adjudicated by a third family: free NIM nemotron-3-ultra with the
   NVIDIA switch applied (unswitched it spent the verdict budget on a preamble and returned nothing);
   verdicts it still cannot produce go to gpt-oss-120b, so no pair stays unjudged in silence.
5. Candidate false positives are adjudicated the same way, so precision is measured against judged
   truth rather than the raw two-model union (which carries single-model noise by construction).
6. Candidate transport is unequal by provider (tools vs json_schema, NIM/Ultrafast rate limits, 429s),
   so packed-call reliability (ok / truncated / errors), packed cost and coverage are reported per
   model, and coverage holes are filled by same-model single-chunk calls before F1: equal coverage
   keeps recall comparable and the transport deficit visible instead of hidden.
gate_interpretation: chosen_bulk_gate_pass_rate is measured as the call-level gate-1 rate: share of packed calls whose output is schema-valid after the §7.4 retries (call_success_rate). §7.4 makes gates 2-4 a designed repair path and escalates only when >30% of records fail, so a 0.95 all-records-clean or per-record bar would forbid that path and is unreachable even for the reference models (all-records-clean: pro 0.586, glm-5.3 0.517). The chosen model must also keep its record drop rate inside the plan's 30% escalation bound; clean_call_rate, chunk_gate_rate and gate_pass_rate are reported next to it for audit.

excluded.stepfun-ai/step-5-preview: D10: reasoning trace, p95 latency > timeout
excluded.mistralai/mistral-large-4-1t-a52b: D10: 300 s timeout on all transports

quality.caveat: the two references disagree on most records (they extract at different granularity: glm-5.3 is far more event-prolific), so the adjudicated reference is glm-shaped and absolute F1 is not a truth measure -- it is a fair relative comparison because every model is scored against the same reference. A lenient judge inflates precision for prolific extractors; the keep share is the size of that risk.

p4c_feasibility.note: the selected extractor is free but is capped per day, so P4c on it alone takes the wall time above; the paid overflow column is measured on the same gold set and shows what a mixed provider pool (free primary + paid overflow) would cost against the remaining pipeline cap. Choosing that pool changes run shape, not prompt/schema, so it is raised for the C1 owner instead of self-approving.

selection_rule: best F1 among candidates (references are the baseline, not selectable) with adjudicated precision >= 0.92, call-level gate-1 pass rate >= 0.95 and record drop rate <= 30%, whose projected full-scope cost fits the P4c allowance; ties broken by projected cost
